scripts.name: Finish merged task
scripts.command: main=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/.." && pwd -P); here=$(pwd -P); [ "$here" = "$main" ] && exit 0; b=$(git branch --show-current); cd "$main" || exit 1; if [ -n "$b" ]; then python3 ../haywire-repo/dev/scripts/finish.py "$b"; else git worktree remove "$here"; fi
